status: Verified the actual Surveyor v0.3.57 updater payload (probe 0.3.35) and published the corrected Runtime-A patch in ready PR #48. The earlier PR #1 is draft and superseded.
summary: Main update-manifest.json points to a full 389848-byte, 29-chunk package with SHA-256 eb8fbc66c20f6dd976018d35fc89aac11023360e5dc3f40c0164be7452fd2126. Reconstructed the ZIP from main chunks and verified hash, size, and archive integrity. It embeds Runtime-A probe 0.3.35. The separate local source ZIP labelled v0.3.57 was 398312 bytes, SHA-256 a29c4863f9321dce98fa5e07c5178fce433d4d212debdd402730ffa48541e4c5, and embeds 0.3.36; it is not the published updater package. The new reproducible patch combines the existing shared-entry owner+0x10 capture with RCX/RDX/[RDX+0x10] snapshot at the same logical-entry hook, preserving separate root-add measurement. Latest upload remains the 0.3.35 artifact and has no registers.
progress: PR #48 targets current main from a fresh branch agent/runtime-dispatch-published-057. Combined patch applies to the verified official 0.3.57 updater ZIP. Focused Runtime-A tests 4/4 passed; full suite 182/182 passed; compileall passed. The 0.3.58 updater chunks/manifest and live NMS validation remain pending Main integration.
blockers: Main integration must build and publish Surveyor 0.3.58 / probe 0.3.37 updater chunks and manifest, then verify app refresh and rollback.

after_build_steps: Surveyor → GitHub / updates → Check for updates → install v0.3.58.
Restart Surveyor; fully exit NMS, then launch NMS from Surveyor.
Enter an accessible derelict only until the root event is captured; no full traversal is needed.
Close NMS and upload the captured root event or all saved evidence.
Tell Runtime-A to check; correlate the entry registers with the exact root descriptor and caller RVA.
